articles.title: A Letter from a New Student
articles.content:
Dear Tom,

How are you? I am writing to tell you about my new school. It is bigger than my old one. There are two playgrounds and a small garden behind the library. My classroom is on the third floor. From the window I can see the sports field.

I have six classes every day. English is my favourite because our teacher plays games with us. At noon I eat lunch with my deskmate, Li Hua. He is funny and helps me with maths. After school we sometimes ride bikes to the bookshop near the gate.

I hope you can visit me this autumn. We can play basketball and read comics together. Please write back soon.

Yours,
Wang Ming

articles.title: How to Make a Simple Fruit Salad
articles.content:
Fruit salad is easy to make and good for you. First, wash your hands and the fruit. You will need two apples, one banana, some grapes, and a little honey. Ask an adult to help if you use a knife.

Cut the apples and the banana into small pieces. Put them in a large bowl. Add the grapes. If you like, you can also add orange pieces. Pour a spoon of honey on top and mix gently. Keep the salad in the fridge for ten minutes before you eat it.

Do not leave the salad outside for too long, especially in summer. Share it with your family. Cooking together is more fun than cooking alone, and a clean kitchen is part of the recipe too.

questions.explanation: 原文：First, wash your hands and the fruit.

questions.explanation: 原文：Cut the apples and the banana into small pieces.
